# Pull Request Template

Thanks for your contribution! Please complete the checklist below. This repository uses a single source-of-truth document: `ARCHITECTURE_AND_EXECUTION_PLAN.md`.

## Summary
- What does this PR change and why?

## Checklists

### Architecture & Documentation
- [ ] If this PR changes architecture, process, SLOs, data model, or APIs, I updated `ARCHITECTURE_AND_EXECUTION_PLAN.md` accordingly.
- [ ] If I updated `ARCHITECTURE_AND_EXECUTION_PLAN.md`, I added a new Change Log entry (Section 15) and/or an ADR entry (Section 13) with context.
- [ ] I linked related PRs/issues and referenced ADR IDs where applicable.

### Backlog & Ownership
- [ ] Updated Backlog statuses/owners in Section 14 if scope or ownership changed.
- [ ] Added PR/commit references to relevant tasks.

### Quality Gates
- [ ] CI passes; the Doc Guardian check is green (see workflow logs if it fails).
- [ ] Security/compliance impact reviewed if applicable (ping: @Jordan-Lee, @Fatima-Al-Hassan).

## Additional Notes
- Dependencies, migrations, or operational notes:
- Screenshots/diagrams if relevant:
